text_block_list.text:
The head-to-head between the
Otherworldly
Front-Runner and the
Empress has been settled!
Эйр Грув is
victorious!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Suzukaaa! She was sooo close!
text_block_list.name: Наблюдатель A

text_block_list.text:
Right? I don't know why, but I couldn't
take my
eyes off her!
text_block_list.name: Spectator B

text_block_list.text: I couldn't catch up!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, I was able to secure victory
today...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: But this is nothing like how I imagined!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: What's wrong, Эйр Грув?
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
You crossed the finish line after me, and
yet...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Everyone only had eyes for you! All they
cared
about was you!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I won the race, yet somehow I didn't
surpass you!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука looked so powerful and
free
during the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She stole everyone's attention, and Air
Groove is
clearly sensitive to the fact
she was outshone.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Don't you dare try and console me,
Suzuka.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I'll do what I must. You do the same.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Just promise me one thing: when I've
grown
strong enough to be worthy of
the title of
Empress...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
And when that time comes, I will be
challenging
you once again!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Not shying away from Эйр Грув's
blazing eyes,
Сайленс Судзука nods in
solemn agreement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув and Сайленс Судзука shake
hands,
sealing their promise to challenge
each other
once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I don't think I'll forget what happened
today for a
long while...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I could hear Эйр Грув's heartbeat
while we were
racing.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
And I could feel her passion burning
right beside
me.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why I couldn't give up
my lead to
her.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука's eyes shine as if the
passion that
burned inside the Empress
has spread, and
smolders within her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I want to become even faster.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука
choice_data_list: We've got summer camp to get through first.

text_block_list.text: Right!
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Thank you. Good night.
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
I watch as she enters the dorm. But just
as I'm
about to make my way home, a
wail cuts through
the air.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Por quuuuué?! I can't believe it!
SUZUKAAA!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
El, it's late. Keep your voice down,
okay?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Right! Sorry!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But... I was watching from the stands!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Even though Suzuka didn't win, her
performance
totally blew me away!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
It feels like there's no way I can beat
her! This
sucks! This sucks, this sucks,
this sucks, this sucks!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
How can I ever become the world's
strongest
racer now?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Gaaah! You've got this, El! Fight! FIGHT!
Run!
Run! ÁNDALE!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Sigh. El, you really need to keep it down.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
She really took off like the wind,
though, didn't
she?
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
And so, the curtains open on a new
challenge.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
